name: clang-tidy
role: the analyzer of both clang-tidy profiles: the build graph fetches it (`@clang_tidy`) for the unit lints (tools/lint/unit_lints.py) on every unit the library links. Pinned because the analysis is only as good as the parse: clang 14 (the distro's) cannot parse a torch-bearing CUDA unit against this toolkit's headers, and the failed parse reported used parameters as unused (measured 2026-09-29); this release parses every unit with zero errors and finds a planted unused parameter and dead store at the end of decode.cu.
upstream: https://github.com/ssciwr/clang-tidy-wheel (LLVM's clang-tidy, built as a wheel with its resource headers, including the CUDA wrappers)
why_not_gated_like_ptxas: clang-tidy reads the source; it never touches codegen, so it is not recorded in the ratified manifest. Its version is still pinned, not ranged: a lint whose findings depend on which clang a host happened to have is two lints.
